name: Nazara Technologies Ltd
title: Nazara Technologies Ltd - 543280 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gaming is now 90% of EBITDA (FY26 gaming EBITDA ₹265 cr, 24.7% margin); no hard FY27 guidance, only qualitative growth and margin expansion claims with Bluetile pro forma EBITDA "at the least would double".

triggers.label: Bluetile acquisition consolidates from Q1 FY27
triggers.quote: We expect to consolidate from Q1 of FY '27.

triggers.label: Bluetile pro forma EBITDA at least doubles
triggers.quote: on a pro forma basis, if you combine these two, then obviously our EBITDA - at the least - would double.

triggers.label: Sportskeeda margin guided up on smaller base
triggers.quote: We actually expect margins to increase in FY '27 on potentially a smaller base.

triggers.label: AdTech Q4 revenue decline, Space and Time
triggers.quote: looking at Q4 specifically, we saw a decline in overall revenue

triggers.label: Fusebox seasonality, Q3 down ~49% QoQ
triggers.quote: in Q3, we had seen almost a 49% Q-on-Q decline due to seasonality

guidance.quote: So, we don't have a specific guidance at this point of time, but very bullish on an overall strong performance on financials in FY '27.

guidance.value: maintain ~50% target margin on signed games
guidance.quote: our margin target is always 50% on any game that we sign.

guidance.value: $100-200 million, mix of primary and secondary
guidance.quote: NODWIN is looking both to raise funds between $100 million to $200 million independently

red_flags.label: Sportskeeda revenue down ~38%, margin compression
red_flags.quote: Sportskeeda remained profitable despite a softer traffic environment, following Google Core updates

red_flags.label: Other income boosted by one-time Rusk gain
red_flags.quote: The other income is predominantly driven by a one-time gain of INR 31 crores on our investment in Rusk Media.

red_flags.label: Lumpy Fusebox seasonality
red_flags.quote: there will be seasonality, as Terry mentioned

evasions.quote: we have yet not seen the kind of recovery we want to see over there.
Ultimately, we are a publisher, so royalties payable to the developers can vary depending on the agreement and the risk.
